[Knowledge](Difficulty level: easy) A memory leak in C occurs when a program allocates memory on the heap
(using functions like malloc(), calloc(), or realloc()) and fails to release it using free() after it is no longer needed.

use it, which eventually exhausts available memory, leading to performance degradation or a system crash.

(whatever happened to be in that memory location). Using an uninitialized pointer is dangerous
and can cause bugs or crashes.
